gloss: to take (with one); to carry away; to bring along

definitions.gloss: to take (with one); to carry away; to bring along
definitions.explanation: To take an object away from the speaker's location to somewhere else. Compound of {持|も}つ (to hold) + {行|い}く (to go). Used when the destination is away from the speaker; contrasts with {持|も}ってくる (to bring here).

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}を{学校|がっこう}に{持|も}っていきました。
examples.english: I took a packed lunch to school.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}に{持|も}っていく{荷物|にもつ}をスーツケースに{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: I packed the luggage I'm taking on the trip into a suitcase.

notes:
Transitive godan verb conjugating like {行|い}く: {持|も}っていく・{持|も}っていって・{持|も}っていった. Often written {持|も}って{行|い}く; the hiragana form もっていく is also common in casual writing. Pairs with {持|も}ってくる for direction.

TRANSITIVITY:
Marks the object with を and the destination with に or へ.
- お{土産|みやげ}を{家|いえ}に{持|も}っていく: to take a souvenir home

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていく: to take an umbrella
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}を{持|も}っていく: to bring lunch
- {忘|わす}れずに{持|も}っていく: to remember to take

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {持|も}ってくる: to bring here — direction toward the speaker
- {運|はこ}ぶ: to carry; transport — focuses on the act of conveying, not direction relative to speaker
